Best Ramen We’ve Ever Had!
May 2026 • Friends
I went there with a group of friends, and we honestly had one of the best dining experiences ever. The ramen was on another level, incredibly flavorful, high quality, and without a doubt the best ramen we’ve ever had. Every dish tasted authentic and perfectly prepared.
What surprised us even more was how reasonable the prices were for such amazing food. The staff were also extremely friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which made the whole experience even better.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for outstanding ramen and a great atmosphere. We’ll definitely come back next time!

Ramen if Your Life Depending On It
Apr 2024 • Friends
We all decided to have ramen for dinner and after reviewing ramen restaurants in Yelp in Old Quarter of Ha Nôi, we selected Yukichi Ramen. Well, we got LUCKY!!!!!! Yukichi offers 3 type of ramen noodles: thin, medium, large size. I love thin noodles because you get to taste the softness and flavorful noodles and the richness of the soup stock. The quail eggs inside the bowl of ramen added a sweet richness to complement the noodles but not taking away from the flavorful richness of the pork soup stock. The potstickers were good but don't forget to add a little of red vinager, sesame oil & palm sugar to their dipping sauce because it was too salty for me. Beside that, this is an amazing spot for ramen. Thank you for not over-charged your ramen noodles like the other ramen restaurants!!!!!
Read more
Insider tip:
You are there for ramen so order ramen and not looking for fried rice, lol!!!!!
